notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: built-in workspace tools for the Sidekick assistant (read-only repo search, safe file read and a project-structure / repo map), all confined to the app-private workspace by a fail-closed path guard and opt-in via a Settings toggle — nothing ever leaves the device. A safe opt-in Skill system (validated, prompt-only instruction packs: code review, Android app audit, commit messages, explain simply) that shape how the assistant answers — text only, no code execution. MCP HTTP failures now distinguish auth vs timeout vs network so misconfigured servers are reported accurately. Existing tools untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal + keyboard, Phone Control (Shizuku/Wireless ADB/root), in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
